text:
Priya Nair: Quick check-in on the Metrics chart — three small items: legend truncation, tick unit text, and how we show single extreme spikes. Low on time so keeping short.
Carlos Vega: Legend: when names truncate we currently show no hover state. Add a hover tooltip with full name and also a keyboard-visible focus outline.
Lina Ho: Units: prefer compact SI on axis (k/M) but avoid `0.0k` and single-letter units like `t`. Tooltip should always show full unit and exact integer values (e.g., "12,345 traces").
Oliver Park: Outlier handling: saw a 50x spike that crushed the scale. Options: clamp at 99th pctile + visible cap, or inset minimap. I prototyped a cap with a small badge that opens a panel listing clipped points.
Design System Bot: Accessibility reminder: legend text on gray must meet 4.5:1. Current orange token fails. Suggested orange #D65A00 meets 4.6:1. Also ensure legend items are reachable via keyboard.
Priya Nair: Smoothing: keep default = raw for alerts dashboards. For overview pages default to a 7-point trend. Add an explicit label that says "Viewing: Raw | Trend (7)". Smoothing should never change exported CSV.
Carlos Vega: UX nit: when series hidden show them at 12% opacity instead of removing from DOM — keeps hover/aria semantics intact.
Lina Ho: Copy tweaks: change tooltip field from "count" to "traces"; aria-labels: "Toggle series <name>, currently visible|hidden". Also ensure the clipped-badge tooltip includes the true value + percentile.
Oliver Park: Small config example from prototype:
```
{
  "yUnit": "traces",
  "axisCompact": true,
  "tickTrimZeros": true,
  "outlier": "clip_99_badge",
  "smoothingDefault": "raw",
  "legendHoverTooltips": true
}
```
Priya Nair: Action items: Carlos to add legend tooltip & keyboard focus; Lina to finalize tooltip/aria copy; Oliver to wire clipped-badge and inset panel; I'll update token proposal. Preview available: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/metrics/ux-legend-1768 — please test contrast and keyboard. Closing thread. :sparkles:
